scope: All 73 ROM fish-profile rows keyed by profile ID: 72 rows with decoded Japanese names and one unresolved 0x0C glyph row. Image matches use exact Japanese-name equality between ROM profiles and existing project capture provenance.
imageNote: The included images are crops of fish pictures shown in gameplay captures, not graphics extracted from the ROM. Each non-null image links to its source video/post, local source frame, and crop rectangle.
